test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8th December 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Two men X and Y working together, completed a job in 6 days. If X had worked thrice as efficiently as he actually worked and Y had worked one-fourth as efficiently as he actually worked, the work would have been completed in 4 days. In how many days X alone could complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by X and Y together = 6 days

If X = 3x and Y = Y/4, time taken = 4 days

The work would have been completed in 4 days.

**Concept used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculation:**

According to Question

X + Y = 1/6 ------- (1)

3 X + Y/4 = 1/4 -------(2)

Solving two equations we get 

Y = 1/11, X = 5/66

So X alone finish the work in 66/5 days.

**∴ The Required Answer is 13 (1)/(5) days.**
